description: List the packages a VPS (vServer) can be upgraded or downgraded to (plan-change targets and custom resource constraints such as CPU cores, RAM and disk). Start here when the user wants a bigger or smaller VPS. Use preview_vserver_plan_change for the full change overview with pricing before applying.

serviceId.description: ID of the VPS: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_vservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

name: get_vserver_plan_change_options
title: Get VPS Plan Change Options
